name: Home Depot CDR (CAD Hedged)
summary: The Home Depot, Inc. sells home improvement products and building materials, including lawn and garden and decor items. It reports U.S., Canada and Mexico geographic segments and also offers installation services plus tool and equipment rental. It was founded in 1978 by Bernard Marcus, Arthur Blank, Kenneth Langone and Pat Farrah and has its head office in Atlanta, Georgia.
